description: This is a FastAPI application source file that implements a backend API for subtitle repositioning, including endpoints for uploading files, starting processing jobs, checking status, previewing results, and downloading processed files. It also manages middleware for request size limits and dynamically imports processing functions.

classes.name: _BodySizeLimitMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class to enforce maximum request body size, configurable via environment variables.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor for _BodySizeLimitMiddleware, initializes with app and max_body_bytes.

methods.name: __call__
methods.description: Handles incoming requests, enforces size limit, and passes through to the app.

methods.name: health_check
methods.description: Health check endpoint to verify the service is running.

methods.name: upload_files
methods.description: Endpoint to upload video and subtitle files, saving them to disk and returning an upload ID.

methods.name: _run_processing
methods.description: Background function to process uploaded files, run subtitle processing, and store results.

methods.name: start_processing
methods.description: API endpoint to initiate processing of uploaded files, returning a job ID.

methods.name: get_status
methods.description: API endpoint to retrieve the current status of a processing job.

methods.name: preview_result
methods.description: API endpoint to preview the processed subtitle file info.

methods.name: download_result
methods.description: API endpoint to download the processed subtitle file.
